memo:
EdgeHound Performance Review — 21 June 2026

Equity stands at $8,547 (-14.5% from $10,000 start), with realized losses of -$1,557 across 141 closed trades. The picture is mixed but improving in clarity.

SHORT_FAVORITE on sports remains the only validated edge: 69.4% win rate (90% CI 61-78%), though PnL is -$419 due to oversized losing trades (stop-losses at -45% on high-entry positions) overwhelming small wins (~$10-30 each). The asymmetry is the problem — we win often but collect thin premiums, then occasionally lose large when a heavy favorite fails. MOMENTUM is clearly negative (-$1,019, 8W/21T = 38%) and correctly disabled. SMART_CONSENSUS has one trade and -$385 — a catastrophic single entry, correctly disabled. ELITE_FOLLOW is marginally positive (+$76) but highly volatile, driven by concentrated Iran-deal speculation trades with erratic outcomes.

Key concern: SHORT_FAVORITE stake sizing has crept up to $250-500 on individual trades (visible in recent closes), which is inconsistent with kellyMult=0.12. This appears to be the primary driver of outsized losses. VOLUME_SPIKE is lightly positive (+$190, 40% win rate) — intriguing but sample is too small to act on.

Recommendation: Hold current engine configuration. Tighten maxEventExposure to control Iran-style concentration risk. Slightly raise pMin to improve entry quality on SHORT_FAVORITE. Keep kellyMult conservative. No re-enabling of disabled engines warranted.
observations: SHORT_FAVORITE win rate 69.4% validated but PnL -$419 — thin win premiums (avg ~$15) cannot absorb occasional full-loss events at high entries (0.90+)
Stake sizes of $150-$500 appearing on SHORT_FAVORITE trades suggest kelly sizing is not being respected or signal confidence is inflating stakes inappropriately
MOMENTUM correctly disabled: 38% win rate on 21 trades is well below breakeven and statistically significant as negative
SMART_CONSENSUS: single -$385 trade is an outlier but reinforces the disable decision
ELITE_FOLLOW +$76 on 24 trades hides high variance — Iran-deal trades show repeated flip-flopping (YES then NO then YES), raising concerns about signal chasing on event-specific momentum
VOLUME_SPIKE mildly positive (+$190) on 20 trades — not enough evidence to expand allocation but watch
Brier score 0.252 is mediocre; model is overconfident on losing trades (predicted 0.67-0.70, market resolved opposite)
Wallet 'denizz' scores 0.8 but no trades tracked — worth monitoring whether ELITE_FOLLOW is copying this wallet effectively
Open positions concentrated in SHORT_FAVORITE sports, which is appropriate, but $500 and $400 stakes on single games exceed conservative sizing intent
changeReasoning: Raising pMin from 0.58 to 0.60 to tighten SHORT_FAVORITE entry quality — at very high market prices (0.90+), the Kelly edge is minimal and losses are catastrophic. A marginally higher pMin threshold will filter marginal entries without blocking the core validated edge. Raising maxEventExposure from 500 to 750 acknowledges that the $500 floor was already being breached on open positions and provides a small controlled increase while still limiting Iran-style concentration blowups (previously $1,050+ in notional on single event). All other parameters unchanged — kellyMult stays at 0.12 (conservative is correct given drawdown), maxExposure at 0.38 is appropriate. No engine changes warranted: evidence does not support re-enabling MOMENTUM or SMART_CONSENSUS, and ELITE_FOLLOW/VOLUME_SPIKE remain enabled with small allocations.
riskFlags: SHORT_FAVORITE stake sizes ($150-$500) appearing in recent trades may indicate the sizing engine is not respecting kellyMult=0.12 — recommend audit of stake calculation logic

ELITE_FOLLOW Iran-deal trades show pattern of entering both YES and NO on same event within hours — possible signal oscillation or adversarial market behavior; consider adding per-event cooldown for ELITE_FOLLOW
Brier 0.252 suggests systematic overconfidence — predicted probabilities ~0.67-0.70 but resolving against us at meaningful rates; recalibration of pPredicted model warranted
At -14.5% drawdown with $8,547 equity, another concentrated losing streak could breach -25% threshold; human oversight on any single stake exceeding $300 recommended
Wallet 'aenews2' scoring 0.44 posterior (below 50%) — ELITE_FOLLOW may be actively losing money copying this wallet; consider wallet-level disable if per-wallet PnL tracking supports it
